g.text: Exact frequency windows and reflected adjoint limits
The weight follows selected centers. The transpose reverses their shift.
Left: an exact nearest-center weight on the displayed interval; later centers remain part of its definition.
Right: exact affine polynomial graphs at four centers, converging to a nonzero scalar. Neither panel plots a solution or support.
